title: the scanner's pattern table and the specification cannot drift apart (spec-side checks run in the maintainer workspace, skipped when the spec is absent)
titleZh: 扫描器的 pattern 表与规格 2.1 不会各说各话(规格侧的断言只在维护者工作区跑,规格缺席时记为 skip)
why: The suite owns its copy of the six forbidden patterns; the normative list lives in the design specification. If somebody adds a seventh pattern to the spec, or renames one here, the two documents start disagreeing and the scan silently stops covering a class of leak. The six assertions against tests/run-tests.ps1 always run. The five assertions against docs/defensive-spec.md describe internal material (listed in .github/scripts/repo-hygiene.ps1 as $InternalMaterial) that is deliberately NOT published, so they carry ifMissing:'skip': in the maintainer workspace that file is present and all eleven assertions run for real; in a published clone the five are reported as SKIP lines and counted in the summary, instead of failing a suite that only ever claimed to be runnable from the published set. Encoding note: titleZh is stored with JSON \u escapes so this touched file stays byte-ASCII; every other case file carries raw UTF-8 Chinese, and the runner reads case.json as explicit UTF-8, so the decoded title is unchanged.
inject: the runner source (always present) and docs/defensive-spec.md (maintainer workspace only; absent from the published set)
expectSummary: 6 pattern names present in tests/run-tests.ps1 (always) + 5 spec-side assertions that run in the maintainer workspace and are reported as SKIP in a published clone
